tools.name: register_catalog
tools.description: Register a tool catalog + probe suite; stores the green state. Free.

tools.name: start_loop
tools.description: Start a recovery loop run against the current live catalog ($0.05 / plan / first run free).

tools.name: apply_fix
tools.description: Serve the revised catalog for a chosen worklist item of an open loop run.

tools.name: verify_recovery
tools.description: Re-probe a loop run whose fix was served and return the signed recovery receipt.

tools.name: server_author_verdict
tools.description: Server-author pre-publish verdict: measure one submitted tool against the curated reference stacks; every verdict names its stack.

tools.name: loop_status
tools.description: Fetch a loop run's status and receipt.
